bq25170.rule_half_C: <= 0.5 C at >= 66 mAh nominal with KISET max and R140 at -1 %: 32.68 mA / 66 mAh = 0.495 C (S1 D-8: 10.0 k gave 0.505 C)
bq25170.precharge_note: 20 % of ICHG between VBAT_SHORT and VBAT_LOWV 2.7-3.0 V (p.7)
bq25170.trickle_note: IBAT_SHORT below VBAT_SHORT 2.1-2.3 V, independent of RISET (p.7): 0.17-0.29 C for 70 mAh
bq25170.term_note: ITERM 10 % (p.7); accuracy given only at 600 Ohm / 3 k / 30 k: at 30 k it is 0.4-1.6 mA for 1 mA nominal (+-60 %), so 3 mA +-60 % (E)

vreg_V.rvset_ok: 36 k +-1 % stays far from the 27 k and 47 k table entries; latched at power-up (p.15)

dropout.note: /PG and charging need VIN > VOUT + VSLEEPZ (95-175 mV, p.6, p.17): at the end of charge (VOUT up to 4.133 V) the head must deliver >= 4.75 V at the contacts (D14 0.43 V max at 33 mA, NSR0240 p.2 interpolated; 0.2 Ohm contacts E). A 5.0 V -5 % head (4.75 V) sits exactly at this limit: V3-G10 head requirement >= 4.85 V at the contacts at 40 mA (below it the charger sleeps near the end of charge and /PG goes high: a few % of capacity lost, no hazard)

bq25170.dissipation_note: head 5.25 V, D14 0.40 V, cell 3.0 V at the CC start, 33 mA (E head); RthJA 75.2 C/W JEDEC (p.5): +4.6 K

iset_rc.source: SLUSDJ8A p.14 7.3.1.1: an extra RC on ISET is recommended below 50 mA; values from SLUAAG9 Figure 5-1 p.4 (2.0 kOhm + 4.7 nF across R-ISET, 45 mA design of the sibling BQ25171-Q1, read as an image in this lane): applicability to the BQ25170 assumed (same ISET detection, E)

ts.duty: ITS_BIAS duty-cycled 100 ms on / 2 s off (p.8, p.17)

window_from_o2.note: while VBUS is present Q8 shorts PV_SW, D19A blocks, so the ladder hangs on the NTC node only through R116 + (chain || U19 supply pin); the MCU is awake (VBUS wakes it through D12A) and NTC_EN is not driven while /PG is low (firmware rule, BASELINE 14 item 10). Q10 off: IDSS <= 1 uA at 20 V (PMZ290), nA at 1 V.
window_from_o2.criterion: cold stop >= 0 C and hot stop <= 45 C at every corner (BASELINE 12, 13.2)
window_from_o2.v3_arch_reference: V3_ARCH 7.4: 1.9-6.0 C / 38.8-44.8 C with the TS bias alone

ts.chg_dis: Q10 on: VTS = 39.5 uA x 0.68 Ohm = 27 uV << VTS_ENZ 40 mV (charge disabled, p.7, PMZ290 p.6)

pg.note: open drain, VOL <= 0.4 V at 5 mA, high-level leakage <= 1 uA with a 3.3 V pull-up (p.7); no typical value: 1 uA is a bound. High level >= 1.64 V against VIH 0.7 x VDD = 1.30 V (nRF52832, E). Low only while the head is attached (8.45 uA from VDD_1V8)

bq25170.iq_out_note: IQ_OUT with IN floating or 0-5 V, charge disabled: 0.35 typ / 0.6 max at 25 C, 0.8 below 105 C (p.6); in BASELINE 11.1 base loads

r_lim.note: charge_point / series_i of v3_energy (RSH1 1 Ohm + series R), k 0.72, cell 3.0 V, every string lit (BASELINE 11.5 convention). Q14 conducts with VGS = -PV_SW (MCU on, Q16) or with the gate held by C174 at -Voc of the approval (MCU off): -1.8 to -2.5 V at the bound points (E)
r_lim.q14_ptot_note: PMZ350UPE / SOT883: a few mW against a Ptot of several 100 mW (same package class as PMZ290 350 mW, p.3): no limit (E)

hysteresis_K.note: internal hysteresis 2/7/17 mV (typ 7 mV) at V_O2 2.0 V, in kelvin at each threshold

ts_window.note: while VBUS is present Q8 shorts PV_SW, D19A blocks, so the ladder hangs on the NTC node only through R116 + (chain || U19 supply pin); the MCU is awake (VBUS wakes it through D12A) and NTC_EN is not driven while /PG is low (firmware rule, BASELINE 14 item 10). Q10 off: IDSS <= 1 uA at 20 V (PMZ290), nA at 1 V.
ts_window.criterion: cold stop >= 0 C and hot stop <= 45 C at every corner (BASELINE 12, 13.2)
ts_window.v3_arch_reference: V3_ARCH 7.4: 1.9-6.0 C / 38.8-44.8 C with the TS bias alone

erm.supply_choice: VBAT_IC (as built): the start current does not cross the BQ25570 PFET; VSTOR (BASELINE 4) compared below

flyback.diode: D17 BAT54CM, both halves in parallel to VBAT_IC

erm.ship_mode: VBAT_IC stays on the cell in ship mode (the BQ25570 opens only the VSTOR-VBAT PFET, SLUSBH2G 7.4.1 p.18): Q12 off-state leakage becomes a ship-mode load: IDSS <= 1 uA at VDS 20 V, 25 C (PMZ290 p.6) is the only published bound; no figure at 4 V (bound 3.7 uW)
erm.hook: BASELINE 14 item 6: INA_BAT (U5 INA236, R112, bus = BATT_P) reads VBAT before the start and the battery current during the 30 ms ramp; the firmware ramps the duty while I_bat <= 40 mA and VBAT_IC - I x 1.0 Ohm >= 3.50 V (keeps VSTOR above VBAT_OK falling max 3.441 V at every corner of the table); never during ECG

front_light_G10h.note: stage 0 wrote 1.5-7.6 mA (derived for R160 = 220 Ohm): a good board would have failed EOL (review D-6)

front_light.choice: 100 Ohm (C270366): >= 3 mA possible at VSTOR_SW 3.31 V with VF 2.9 V; peak <= 16.8 mA at 4.28 V with VF 2.6 V (the LED's VF rises with current, so the real peak is lower) against 25 mA absolute maximum of the 1.28 in part (AZ11049 p.2); 220 Ohm (the first value) cannot give the 3 mA dim-room level below VSTOR_SW 3.56 V

energy_uW.note: battery-referred: I_avg x 3.7 V (R160, LED and Q11 are all in this product)

front_light.pwm: PWM duty = target average / peak, the firmware reads VSTOR on INA_BAT and corrects for it; the VF spread stays (open loop, brightness +-30 % E)
front_light.q11: PMZ290UNE2 0.68 Ohm max at 1.8 V: 11 mV at the peak

a_port.note: SCES937B p.8: VT+ 0.76-1.13 V at 1.65 V and 1.08-1.56 V at 2.3 V, VT- 0.35-0.69 / 0.56-0.97 V (interpolated to VCCA); nRF outputs at light load within 50 mV of the rails (E)

b_port.ok: VCCB = panel VDD (same rail VDD_DISP), so VOH >= VDD - 0.1 V meets VIH >= VDD - 0.1 V at the panel's uA input current; LD-29Y03 Table 6-1 spec p.18; SCES937B p.9

display_if.edges: SCES937B p.10: 100 Mbps for 1.65-1.95 V -> 3.0-3.6 V with 20 % of the pulse above 0.7 VCCO, i.e. edges of a few ns; the panel asks <= 50 ns (LD-29Y03 spec p.22): met with margin (inference from the data-rate row, E)

supply_currents_uA.note: SCES937B p.9 / SCES940A p.7: ICCA + ICCB max 2.5 (25 C) / 3 (85 C) / 6 uA (125 C); no typical value published (V3_ARCH lists the TXU0104 typical as not found)

display_if.sequence: on: DISP_EN high (U16 EN, VCCA, OE) -> wait >= 1.2 ms (tSTR 0.75-1.2 ms, SBVS277C p.7) -> panel init with DISP_CTRL low -> DISP_CTRL high. off: DISP_CTRL low -> wait >= 30 us (LD-29Y03 spec p.21) -> DISP_EN low (U16 discharges VDD_DISP through 60 Ohm, p.7; both translators go high-Z once a supply is < 100 mV, SCES937B p.1). Below 100 mV of VCCB the DISP input is undriven for the first part of the VDD ramp (E: check on the bench, V3-G10 (g))

tps7a0230.en: VEN(HI) >= 1.1 V, VEN(LOW) <= 0.3 V, IEN <= 10 nA (p.7): driven by DISP_EN at 1.86 V

panel_power_uW.source: LD-29Y03 Table 6-4 spec p.24 at 3.0 V, 60 Hz EXTCOMIN

vbus.note: VBUS 5.0 V -> R144 / R145 1 M / 1 M -> VB_DET 2.5 V -> D12 half A -> EN_HOLD (C121 4.7 uF, R126 3.3 M to the dark PV node): Q4 on, EN low; VB_DET also turns on Q8 (PV short) and Q9 (AVDD_EN low) at VGS 2.5 V

button.note: SW1 closes BTN_SUP (VBAT_IC through R165 100 k) to BTN (R167 1 M): BTN 0.91 x VBAT -> D12 half B -> EN_HOLD; BTN -> Q13 gate -> BTN_N low. Running: EN_HOLD already 1.27-1.46 V (D9), so BTN starts at EN_HOLD + VF and Q13 switches at once; ship mode: a press of >= 0.3 s wakes (strict 1.0 V), then MCUboot holds PWR_HOLD. C&K contact <= 500 mOhm, bounce <= 10 ms, 50 mA / 12 V max (PTS840 p.1): 4 uA is a dry circuit (E: gold-plated contacts would be the safer finish; the GK finish is not stated in the notes)

wake.stuck_button: water pressure or a stuck key: 3.7 uA in R165 + R167 and 1.9 uA in R164 (when awake) = about 21 uW while held; firmware ignores > 5 s (BASELINE 14 item 5); in ship mode a held key keeps EN_HOLD up, so the band leaves ship mode (E: SHELF then applies)

leakage.d12: ship mode: anodes at 0 V (R145, R167 to GND) and cathode at EN_HOLD = 0 V: no bias, no current. Running: reverse bias about 1.3 V, IR <= 30 nA at 25 V (BAV70M p.4) per half: < 0.06 uA from the hold node (fed by PWR_HOLD)
leakage.r144_r145: 0 with the head off (VBUS_K floating, D14 blocks)

contact_esd.parts: J15 (VBUS_K) -> D13 ESD761 to GND at the land -> D14 NSR0240 -> VBUS -> C130 1 uF at U15 IN; J18 = GND

positive.note: the residual after D13 is charge-limited by C130 through D14: about 2 V on the input capacitor against the 30 V absolute maximum of IN (SLUSDJ8A p.4); ESD761 clamps 36.3 V at 1.8 A 8/20 us, IEC 61000-4-2 +-15 kV (SLVSH10C p.4-5)

negative.d14_reverse_V: up to the ESD761 clamp, 36.3 V at 1.8 A plus the dynamic part at the IEC peak (not stated) against NSR0240 VR 40 V (p.1)
negative.status: margin small and not specified for ns pulses: V3-G6 ESD test on the contacts with the head off; fallback a 60 V Schottky in the same land

reverse_attach.at_minus5V: D14 blocks: BQ25170 IN stays >= -0.3 V (p.4); ESD761 VRWM +-24 V: no conduction (p.4); current <= 0.55 uA (NSR0240 p.2)

contact_esd.standby: head off: VBUS_K floats, D13 leakage <= 50 nA only with a voltage on the pin (SLVSH10C p.4): 0 in use

standby.note: BASELINE 11.1 values (battery-referred, 3.7 V) with the as-built differences; 'bound' items have only a datasheet maximum (no typical): the real values are expected far lower but are not published (unverified - needs samples). T6 >= 182.6 d (BASELINE 11.2)
